info.title: Arvlet Agent API
info.description: Artifacts and append-only records. No task prerequisite. Single-owner workspace; Bearer token has full workspace access. Content versions and interaction state are independent. Reload on revision conflict; do not blindly overwrite.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique per logical write. Same key and input replays the committed result; different input returns 409. Keys do not expire in v0.1.
